# Super Contests

At the Contest Hall in Hearthome City, in both versions. Three receptionists: the middle counter is for entering, the right one for practice. The left one is for link contests, which aren't available.

## Entering

Five contests: Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart, Tough. Four ranks: Normal, Great, Ultra, Master. Any Pokémon with at least two moves can enter Normal Rank, not an Egg or a fainted Pokémon. To enter a higher rank the Pokémon needs the ribbon of every lower rank of that contest. So win Normal to enter Great, and so on. A Master winner can enter Master again as often as you like.

Four Pokémon compete, three opponents and you. Each contest has three stages, which count equally: each stage's score is measured against the best score of that stage, and the three are added. A tie is decided at random.

## Visual

Dress your Pokémon in 60 seconds on the touch screen: drag Accessories from the shelf on the left onto your Pokémon, and back to take one off. You can put on 5 in Normal, 10 in Great, 15 in Ultra, 20 in Master Rank. The contest names a theme:

The Shapely, The Sharp, The Created, The Natural, The Colorful, The Solid, The Bright, The Gaudy, The Flexible, The Festive, The Intangible, The Relaxed.

**Score:** hearts, from two things.

- **Condition.** The contest's own stat, plus half of the two stats next to it and of Sheen. (Cool's neighbours are Tough and Beauty; the order is Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart, Tough, in a circle.) A scarf held adds 10% when it's the contest's colour and 5% for a neighbour's colour: Red Cool, Blue Beauty, Pink Cute, Green Smart, Yellow Tough. The scarf man in Pastoria doesn't give them in 1.0, so a scarf has to come from a trade.
- **Dress.** Each Accessory scores for the theme. Wearing any scoring Accessory gives a heart, and a higher total gives up to 3 more.

Condition gives a heart for each step reached, up to 8; the steps rise with the rank:

| Rank | Condition steps | Dress steps |
|---|---|---|
| Normal | 10, 20, 30 ... 80 | above 3, 5, 8 |
| Great | 90, 110, 130 ... 230 | above 5, 10, 15 |
| Ultra | 170, 200, 230 ... 380 | above 7, 15, 23 |
| Master | 320, 360, 400 ... 600 | above 10, 20, 30 |

## Dance

The four Pokémon take turns leading. Make your steps to the beat by touching the screen, or with the +Control Pad, or A (right), B (down), X (up) and Y (left). When you lead, you make the steps; when you follow, copy the lead's steps on the matching beats right after. Normal and Great use a song of three steps a measure, Ultra and Master one of four.

**Score:** each step scores 2 if near the beat, 1 if close, 0 if far off. A follower who makes a different step than the lead's scores 0.

## Acting

Four rounds. Each round your Pokémon uses one of its moves in front of one of three judges. You can't use the same move two rounds running, unless its effect allows it.

**Score:** each heart is 10 points.

- **Effect.** Each move has its own hearts and effect, shown on its card.
- **Judge.** Each judge has a Voltage up to 5 stars. A move of the contest's type raises it a star; a move of a neighbouring type does nothing; the others lower it. Reaching 5 stars gives that Pokémon 5 hearts, or 8 if the judge is the head judge. That judge's Voltage then starts again from none.
- **Spread out.** Fewer rivals at your judge means more points: alone 3 hearts, with one other 2, with two others 1, with all three 0.

## Ribbons and prizes

A win gives your Pokémon that contest and rank's Ribbon, which opens the next rank. The first win of each rank and contest also gives you an Accessory:

| Contest | Normal | Great | Ultra | Master |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cool | Red Barrette | Red Balloons | Top Hat | Gold Pedestal |
| Beauty | Blue Barrette | Blue Balloons | Silk Veil | Glass Stage |
| Cute | Pink Barrette | Pink Balloon | Lace Headdress | Flower Stage |
| Smart | Green Barrette | Green Balloons | Professor Hat | Cube Stage |
| Tough | Yellow Barrette | Yellow Balloon | Heroic Headband | Award Podium |

## Accessories

They go in the Fashion Case. You can hold up to 9 of each of the first 61 kinds and one of each of the others.

- **The Fashion Case:** someone from Jubilife TV gives it to you in Jubilife City during the story, with five Accessories at random from White Fluff, Yellow Fluff, Pink Fluff, Brown Fluff, Black Fluff, Orange Fluff and five from Blue Feather, Red Feather, Yellow Feather, White Feather, Black Moustache, White Moustache.
- **Masks:** three people give you one each, by your starter: Jubilife TV 2F, the Veilstone Department Store 1F and Pastoria City. You end up with the Turtwig Mask, Chimchar Mask and Piplup Mask.
- **The massage girl in Veilstone City**: a massage a day, and she may find one of these you don't have at full count: Pretty Dewdrop, Snow Crystal, Sparks, Shimmering Fire, Mystic Fire, Determination, Peculiar Spoon, Puffy Smoke, Poison Extract, Wealthy Coin, Eerie Thing, Spring, Seashell, Humming Note, Shiny Powder, Glitter Powder.
- **Amity Square** in Hearthome: walk with one of the Pokémon below. Every 200 steps it may find something, from its row, with these odds: 15%, 15%, 15%, 15%, 10%, 10%, 8%, 5%, 5%, 2% from left to right.

| Walking with | Accessories, most common first |
|---|---|
| Clefairy, Skitty | White Fluff, Orange Fluff, White Feather, Mini Pebble, Small Leaf, Blue Scale, White Beard, Thin Mushroom, Big Scale, Stump |
| Torchic, Drifloon | Pink Fluff, Red Feather, Yellow Feather, Black Beard, Narrow Scale, White Fluff, White Moustache, Shed Claw, Narrow Leaf, Purple Scale |
| Psyduck, Pachirisu | Snaggy Pebble, Jagged Boulder, Brown Fluff, Mini Pebble, Black Moustache, Shed Horn, Narrow Scale, Round Pebble, Green Scale, Thick Mushroom |
| Jigglypuff, Shroomish | Pink Scale, Blue Feather, White Feather, Blue Scale, Thin Mushroom, Jagged Boulder, White Beard, Black Beard, Big Leaf, Round Pebble |
| Pikachu | Orange Fluff, Brown Fluff, Small Leaf, Red Feather, Yellow Feather, Yellow Fluff, Glitter Boulder, Big Scale, Black Moustache, Purple Scale |
| Buneary, Happiny | Pink Scale, Shed Horn, Pink Fluff, Yellow Feather, Shed Claw, Black Fluff, Snaggy Pebble, Big Leaf, Green Scale, Black Pebble |

- **First wins:** the table above.

## Stand-ins in this version

These are known and on the [known issues](known-issues.md) page: hearts, Voltage and result bars are numbers, the top screen shows numbers rather than your dressed Pokémon during Visual, the curtain doesn't count toward Visual's score, and Black 2's sounds stand in for some of the contest's.

Poffins raise the condition stats these stages read: see [Poffins](poffins.md).
